nodes.short_description: Downtown Club is een uiterst verzorgd stedelijk motorsportspel dat van de grond af is gebouwd voor VR, met geavanceerde bewegingsbesturing en opwindende rijbeleving. Grijp het stuur en maak je klaar voor een duel met formidabele tegenstanders!
Downtown Clubは、VR向けにゼロから作られた洗練された都市型モータースポーツゲームです。最先端のモーションコントロールと爽快なドライビングフィードバックを備えています。ステアリングを握り、手強い相手との激闘に備えよう！

Downtown Club este un joc de motorsport urban extrem de rafinat, construit de la zero pentru VR, cu controale de mișcare de ultimă generație și senzații de condus captivante. Apucă volanul și pregătește-te să concurezi împotriva unor adversari redutabili!

Downtown Club to wysoce dopracowana miejska gra motorsportowa, zbudowana od podstaw dla VR, z najnowocześniejszym sterowaniem ruchowym i ekscytującymi odczuciami podczas jazdy. Chwyć kierownicę i przygotuj się na wyścig z zaciekłymi rywalami!
Downtown Club은 VR을 위해 처음부터 제작된 세련된 도시 모터스포츠 게임으로, 최첨단 모션 컨트롤과 짜릿한 주행 피드백을 제공합니다. 핸들을 잡고 강력한 상대들과 레이스를 펼칠 준비를 하세요!

Downtown Club is a highly polished urban motorsport game built from the ground up for VR, featuring state-of-the-art motion controls and exciting driving feedback. Grab the steering wheel and get ready to race against fierce opponents!

Downtown Club är ett noggrant genomarbetat stadsbaserat motorsportspel byggt från grunden för VR, med toppmoderna rörelsekontroller och en spännande körkänsla. Ta tag i ratten och gör dig redo att tävla mot tuffa motståndare!

Downtown Club ist ein hochwertiges urbanes Motorsportspiel, das von Grund auf für VR entwickelt wurde, mit modernster Bewegungssteuerung und aufregendem Fahrgefühl. Schnapp dir das Lenkrad und bereite dich darauf vor, gegen starke Gegner anzutreten!

Downtown Club è un gioco di motorsport urbano estremamente curato, costruito da zero per VR, con controlli di movimento all'avanguardia e un feedback di guida emozionante! Afferra il volante e preparati a gareggiare contro avversari formidabili!

Downtown Club est un jeu de sport automobile urbain très soigné, conçu de A à Z pour la VR, avec des contrôles de mouvement de pointe et des retours de conduite passionnants. Prenez le volant et préparez-vous à affronter des adversaires redoutables !

Downtown Club é um jogo de automobilismo urbano altamente refinado, desenvolvido do zero para VR, com controles de movimento de última geração e feedback de direção emocionante. Agarre o volante e prepare-se para enfrentar adversários implacáveis!

¡Downtown Club es un juego de deportes de motor urbano muy cuidado, construido desde cero para VR, con controles de movimiento de última generación y una respuesta de conducción emocionante. Agarra el volante y prepárate para competir contra rivales despiadados!
Downtown Club是一款精心打造的都市赛车运动游戏，专为独立VR平台从零构建，配备最先进的体感操控和令人心跳加速的驾驶反馈。握紧方向盘，踏上赛道，全力冲刺，与强劲对手一决高下！

nodes.long_description:
🔰 NOW IN EARLY ACCESS 🔰

Downtown Club is a racing game with full physical controls and exciting driving feedback, built from the ground up for standalone VR. Grab wheel, shifter and handbrake, take full control of your car and become a motorsport champion!

Get behind the wheel of nimble city cars and race against a full grid of fierce opponents, or race against the clock and put your record on top of the worldwide leaderabords. And when it's time to cool down, drive freely around the map at your own pace.

Downtown Club will launch in early access: new cars, new maps, online multiplayer and other features will soon be added with free updates!
nodes.short_description: Grab wheel, shifter and handbrake, take full control of your car and become a motorsport champion in this racing game built from the ground up for standalone VR!

nodes.change_log:
- Added functions to vote-kick and report online players
- Added a new Player Hub list to only show in-room players
- Added a page with online multiplayer rules
- Added three new control layouts, including one-handed ones
- Added an option to swap control thumbsticks in any control layout
- Updated Quick Race hop-in flow to prevent rejoin abuse
- Updated Controls Layout settings page
- Updated onboarding Settings page
- Updated tutorial to work with any control layout
- Fixed virtual shifter not moving after shifting with buttons
- Fixed slipstream effect not showing in Free Ride
- Fixed Comfort options info UI
- Other minor fixes and updates

- Fixed multiplayer freezing when mic permission was denied
- Other minor fixes

- Added back the option to turn off windshield reflections
- Fixed player spawning below the track in specific situations
- Fixed interpolation getting stuck on lagging networked players
- Fixed music not lowering when the local player is speaking

- Improved voice chat transmission during scene loading
- Improved out of bounds detection
- Increased car rollover on strong collisions
- Fixed profile bar not refreshing correctly during Events
- Fixed car selection not remembering the last paint used
